success.description: You call upon the favour of the Dark Gods of Chaos. You and all allies within close range gain § +1 to Willpower and +1 Fellowship while this spell is recharging.
Above, and you and all allies within close range also gain +1 to Strength and +1 Toughness. You recover 1 stress and 1 fatigue.

chaosStar.description: You and all allies within close range gain 1 corruption.

sigmarsComet.description: Add 1 recharge token to this card. @ Remove 1 recharge token from the spell. You suffer 1 wound.
